observations: Photo 0: Front view of a silver laptop with black keyboard, HP logo on screen bezel, 'ELITEBOOK' engraved on palm rest, Intel Core i5 sticker on lower right of keyboard area. Screen shows Windows desktop with a car wallpaper.
Photo 1: Back view of the same silver laptop, showing the HP logo (three horizontal bars) centered on the lid.

Photo 2: Same front view as photo 0, but from a slightly different angle, showing the same details: screen, keyboard, 'ELITEBOOK' engraving, Intel Core i5 sticker. Screen still shows Windows desktop with car wallpaper.
All photos have a watermark 'MCKENZIE COMPUTER TECH'.
No visible damage or wear in the photos. No ports, hinges, or underside shown.
No model number or serial number visible in any photo.

claims.evidence: No model number visible in any photo. The 'ELITEBOOK' name is visible on the palm rest (photo 0, photo 2), but not the specific model 840 G9.
Intel Core i5 sticker visible in photo 0 and photo 2, but it does not specify the generation. The sticker says 'Intel Core i5' but not '12th gen'.
No fingerprint reader visible in any photo. The touchpad is shown, but no fingerprint sensor is apparent. The seller's claim cannot be verified from the images.
No internal components shown. Cannot verify storage or RAM from photos alone. Requires system information or BIOS screen.

risks.risk: The laptop may not be an HP EliteBook 840 G9 as claimed.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the model label, usually on the bottom of the laptop or near the hinge.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a generic HP EliteBook, which may be lower than the 840 G9.

risks.risk: The CPU may not be 12th gen Intel Core i5.
risks.proof: A screenshot of the system information or BIOS showing the exact CPU model.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as an older or lower-tier i5, which reduces value.

risks.risk: No fingerprint reader is visible, so the claim may be false.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the touchpad area showing the fingerprint sensor, or a video demonstrating its use.
risks.if_unproven: Priced without fingerprint reader, which reduces value.

risks.risk: The SSD and RAM specifications may be inaccurate or upgraded/downgraded.
risks.proof: A screenshot of the system information showing storage and RAM details, or a photo of the internal components.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as if it has unknown or lower specs, which reduces value.

risks.risk: Hidden damage or wear not visible in photos, such as hinge issues, screen defects, or keyboard problems.
risks.proof: A video showing the laptop being opened, closed, and used, including a close-up of the screen and keyboard.
risks.if_unproven: Priced with a discount for potential hidden defects.

proof_requests: A clear photo of the model label on the bottom of the laptop.
A screenshot of the system information showing CPU, RAM, and storage details.
A close-up photo or video of the touchpad area to confirm the presence of a fingerprint reader.
A video showing the laptop being opened, closed, and used, including screen and keyboard close-ups.
response.reason: The model, CPU generation, and fingerprint reader cannot be verified from the current photos. The internal specs (SSD/RAM) are also unverifiable. Without proof, the item cannot be accurately priced, and hidden risks may affect value.
